notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR1: "A CD entry must appear only in the Communication Section." The CD level indicator is reachable only through communicationDescriptionEntry, which only communicationSection contains (dataDivision orders it after LINKAGE, as 1985 does), so a CD anywhere else is a parse error. Probed at --std 85: a CD in WORKING-STORAGE, FILE, LINKAGE, LOCAL-STORAGE and REPORT sections each refused (COBOL0001 unexpected CD); all three formats in the Communication Section, also after a LINKAGE SECTION, compile and run; a stray 01 before the first CD is refused. The witness refuses a CD in WORKING-STORAGE.

next.reason: 1985: "A CD entry must appear only in the Communication Section."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the CD entry or Communication Section; the candidates cover only report, data, screen and file entries.". No 2023 clause holds the communication feature. The wording candidates restrict other entries only, so 2023 lacks the CD entry and its placement rule.
